text:
alex: Heads-up — canary promo held by deploy-bot. Staging e2e job (integration-suite) failing on one node: kube OOM + artifact cache hash mismatch when pulling cached wheel. Seen twice in a row.

morgan: Can you paste the failing test/logs?

alex: sure
```
ERROR: OOMKilled
fetching artifact wheel: checksum mismatch: expected sha256:3f8a... got sha256:7d2b...
Traceback (most recent call last): ...
``` 

sam: deploy-bot posted hold: `promo-blocked: canary/staging - artifact-integrity-failure`

tia: is this the same cache shard we had issues with last week?

morgan: looks related to the registry multipart reupload race — digest flip.

alex: pipeline shows `ci-cache-restore` step succeeded but `extract_wheel` fails. suspect corrupt cached layer.

tia: suggestion: pin to last-promoted image (`gcr/redwood/canary@sha256:abc123`) and rerun canary headless smoke. If good, manually promote.

sam: tradeoff: pin avoids rollback but delays rollout. change window is open for 30m.

morgan: alternative: force reupload artifact from buildkite job, but that requires rebuild and will push back by ~45m.

alex: ops: can you check registry logs for blob upload around 12:14 UTC? @tia

tia: checking now, saw `PUT /blobs/uploads/` retry 503 between 12:13-12:15. attaching snippet.
```
2025-11-05T12:14:02Z registry: upload blob retry err: 503
2025-11-05T12:14:05Z registry: completed upload digest=sha256:7d2b...
```

sam: that matches checksum flip. I'm leaning to pin+rerun canary then roll forward if green.

morgan: +1. Also add a guard in deploy-bot to check artifact digest before release (if not already).

deploy-bot: promo-hold created by auto-checker. Assigned: @alex, @tia. Suggested action: manual-pin or rebuild.

alex: I'll pin to last good image and kick a headless smoke now. Will update in thread.

(15m later)

alex: headless smoke finished: e2e ok on 3/3 nodes. No checksum errors. Manual promote in progress.

tia: registry team says they will backfill failure telemetry and add retry backoff. Follow-up ticket: REG-1223.

sam: Good unblocking. Leave note in release notes about transient registry upload issue and the manual pin. I'll update release notes and cc security for audit.

morgan: awesome. Can we add a canary check in deploy-bot to validate artifact digests across regions before auto-promote? Feature request: DEPLOY-56.

alex: filed DEPLOY-56 and linked REG-1223. Closing this thread after promote completes.

sam: :thumbsup:
